title: Autotune: default batching/caching and quantization profiles + unit-econ tooling
author: Aisha Patel
description:
Context: The platform needs safer defaults for batching and prefix/KV caching and first-class quantization profiles surfaced to the autotune service to reduce per-token costs across common workloads. This PR implements autotune defaults that pick batching/caching heuristics from observed traffic patterns, adds curated quantization profiles for popular open models, and exposes a small unit-economics CLI + console panel to help ops teams measure estimated $/1M tokens and projected savings.

Summary of changes: added default heuristic engine, quant profile registry and selector, UEcon tooling (CLI + console endpoints), rollout flag and experiment framework. Includes automated checks and integration tests against the perf-canary harness.

Checklist:
- [x] Implement default batching/caching heuristics and config merge logic
- [x] Add quantization profile registry + fallback selection rules
- [x] Add unit-econ CLI and console endpoints + basic dashboard
- [x] Add feature flag + canary rollout support
- [x] Add unit and integration tests; update docs
- [x] Update changelog and release notes

Testing: unit tests for defaults and quant selector included; integration tests run in perf-canary and passed after a single flaky e2e rerun. Manual validation on staging measured ~18-25% token cost reduction for mid-length chat workloads when using recommended profiles and caching improvements.

Rollout plan: behind feature flag. Start with internal beta on Dedicated clusters for 1 week, run UEcon report daily, then expand to 10% traffic on hosted API, monitor latency P99 and quality regressions via eval harness. Automatic fallback to prior profiles if error rate or latency regresses by configured thresholds.

Motivation: Customers frequently ask for better out-of-the-box cost settings and guided quantization recommendations; this reduces time-to-savings and provides guardrails for quality.

Notes: Will follow up with a separate PR to add more model-specific quant profiles and integrate the Recommend API in the SDKs.
commits: feat(autotune): add default batching and KV-caching heuristics; feat(quant): add curated quantization profile registry and selector; feat(uecon): add CLI and console endpoints for unit economics; fix(tests): add integration tests for perf-canary; docs: update autotune/uecon docs; ci: add e2e smoke to checks
review_comments: Diego: please add more integration coverage for stress conditions — requested added test for high-concurrency KV cache eviction; Samir: questioned fallback semantics for unseen models — clarified selector falls back to 'balanced' profile and added explicit tests; Leah: suggested adding UEcon CLI sample output in docs — added screenshots and example CLI output. Author: addressed comments, added tests and docs updates, force-pushed a single squash commit.
